aboutGame.title: What is Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2?
paragraphs: Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 is a standalone ten-episode anime produced by Studio TRIGGER with CD PROJEKT RED, set in the same Night City as Cyberpunk 2077. Instead of continuing David Martinez's story, it follows four new leads, the washed-up legend Weak Kingsley, the netrunner D, the cinephile Roman Carax, and the fiercely independent Talia Yang, whose lives become entangled to the extreme as they chase family, obsession, legacy, and revenge.

All ten episodes premiere on Netflix on October 20, 2026, so the whole season can be watched in one sitting. Kai Ikarashi directs, Ichigo Kanno handles character design, Tsuneo Imahori composes the music, and Bartosz Sztybor returns as showrunner and writer. This wiki tracks every confirmed character, episode detail, trailer, and release update as new material lands.

items.question: What is Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2?
items.answer: Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 is a standalone ten-episode anime produced by Studio TRIGGER with CD PROJEKT RED, set in the same Night City as Cyberpunk 2077 with an all-new crew of edgerunners.

items.question: When does Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 release on Netflix?
items.answer: Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 premieres on October 20, 2026, and all ten episodes arrive on Netflix at the same time, so the entire season can be watched in one sitting.

items.question: Do I need to watch the first Cyberpunk: Edgerunners before Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2?
items.answer: No. Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 is billed as a standalone story with a new cast, so newcomers can start here, while returning fans will still recognize plenty of Night City landmarks.

items.question: Who are the main characters in Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2?
items.answer: Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 centers on four leads: the washed-up legend Weak Kingsley, the Snake Nation netrunner D, the cinephile Roman Carax, and the Maelstrom-raised Talia Yang.

items.question: Who makes Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2?
items.answer: Studio TRIGGER produces Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 with CD PROJEKT RED. Kai Ikarashi directs, Ichigo Kanno handles character design, Tsuneo Imahori composes the music, and Bartosz Sztybor returns as showrunner and writer.

items.question: Is Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 suitable for younger viewers?
items.answer: Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 carries a TV-MA rating and is aimed at mature audiences because of its violence, language, and adult themes, so parents should screen it before a family watch.
